findings.title: Credential embedded in MCP server `github` (GitHub token)
findings.rationale: Secrets in `env`, `args`, `headers` or the URL of a server are stored in plaintext and shared with every process that can read the file.
findings.remediation: Reference an environment variable (`${VAR}`) or a secret manager instead of the literal value.

findings.title: Credential embedded in MCP server `remote-tools` (JWT)
findings.rationale: Secrets in `env`, `args`, `headers` or the URL of a server are stored in plaintext and shared with every process that can read the file.
findings.remediation: Reference an environment variable (`${VAR}`) or a secret manager instead of the literal value.

findings.title: Credential in URL of MCP server `remote-tools`
findings.rationale: Secrets in `env`, `args`, `headers` or the URL of a server are stored in plaintext and shared with every process that can read the file.
findings.remediation: Move the token to a header sourced from the environment.

findings.title: MCP server `remote-tools` uses plaintext HTTP to a remote host
findings.rationale: Tool calls and results (often including file contents) cross the network unencrypted and can be read or modified in transit; a modified tool result is a prompt-injection vector.

findings.title: MCP server `installer` pipes a download into a shell
findings.rationale: `curl … | sh` style launchers fetch arbitrary code on every start with no pinning or integrity check.
findings.remediation: Install the server once, verify it, and launch the installed binary.

findings.title: MCP server `filesystem` runs unpinned package `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`
findings.rationale: `npx -y pkg`, `pkg@latest` or `uvx pkg` resolves and executes whatever the registry serves at launch time. A compromised or typosquatted release runs with your privileges on next start.
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version (e.g. `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@X.Y.Z`) or install once and point `command` at the binary.

findings.title: MCP server `github` runs unpinned package `@modelcontextprotocol/server-github@latest`
findings.rationale: `npx -y pkg`, `pkg@latest` or `uvx pkg` resolves and executes whatever the registry serves at launch time. A compromised or typosquatted release runs with your privileges on next start.
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version (e.g. `@modelcontextprotocol/server-github@X.Y.Z`) or install once and point `command` at the binary.

findings.title: MCP server `tmp-binary` launched from a temporary directory
findings.rationale: A bare command name is resolved by PATH at launch; a writable earlier PATH entry or a temp directory lets another process substitute the binary.
findings.remediation: Install the server under a user- or system-owned directory.

findings.title: MCP server `filesystem` scoped to `/`
findings.rationale: Filesystem-style servers take allowed roots as arguments; `/`, `~` or the home directory exposes every credential and repository on the machine to the model.
findings.remediation: Pass the specific project directories instead.

findings.title: MCP server `path-binary` command `my-mcp-server` resolved via PATH
findings.rationale: A bare command name is resolved by PATH at launch; a writable earlier PATH entry or a temp directory lets another process substitute the binary.
findings.remediation: Use the absolute path of the binary.
